inputs.text: New York City’s sanctuary approach put ideology ahead of public safety: authorities released an illegal immigrant gang member despite the danger he posed, and ICE had to step in. When local officials obstruct federal immigration enforcement, ordinary people bear the risk. A government’s first duty is to protect its citizens and uphold the law—not make excuses for releasing people with criminal records.
